ears_text: WHEN a production tag is created, the version control system shall create it as an annotated tag named v<major>.<minor>.<patch>.
test_script:
import re
import subprocess

import pytest

PROJECT = "/project"

PRODUCTION_RE = re.compile(r"^v(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)$")
# Pre-release tags (release candidates, etc.) are not production tags.
PRERELEASE_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)(^|[-_.+])(rc|alpha|beta|pre|preview|dev|snapshot)[-_.]?\d*")


def _git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-c", f"safe.directory={PROJECT}", "-C", PROJECT, *args],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )


def _tags():
    res = _git(
        "for-each-ref",
        "--format=%(refname:strip=2) %(objecttype)",
        "refs/tags",
    )
    assert res.returncode == 0, f"git for-each-ref failed: {res.stderr}"
    tags = []
    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        name, objtype = line.rsplit(" ", 1)
        tags.append((name, objtype))
    return tags


def test_production_tags_are_annotated_semver():
    inside = _git("rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree")
    bare = _git("rev-parse", "--is-bare-repository")
    assert inside.returncode == 0 or bare.returncode == 0, (
        f"{PROJECT} is not a git repository: {inside.stderr}"
    )

    tags = _tags()
    production = [(n, t) for n, t in tags if not PRERELEASE_RE.search(n)]

    violations = []
    for name, objtype in production:
        if not PRODUCTION_RE.match(name):
            violations.append(
                f"{name!r}: production tag name does not match v<major>.<minor>.<patch>"
            )
        if objtype != "tag":
            violations.append(
                f"{name!r}: is a lightweight tag (object type {objtype!r}), not annotated"
            )

    assert not violations, "Production tag violations:\n" + "\n".join(violations)
notes: Audits every production tag in history — a single old badly-named tag would fail it forever. Needs narrowing to the newest tag before activation (the project's own rule: judge only the newest).
